description: Steps after a parenthesized variable are not a static traversal
notes: The spec makes a variable expression with attribute access and constant index operations a static traversal without saying whether parentheses, which only group in evaluation, keep it one. hashicorp/hcl makes the steps a RelativeTraversalExpr whose AsTraversal (hclsyntax/expression.go) needs a traversal from its source, and the source is a ParenthesesExpr, which has no AsTraversal method and can't be unwrapped.
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
